Coarse crisp visible pixel clusters, compact readable furnishings, upper-left daylight, no blurred painterly strokes, no glow. No readable text, names, labels, UI or watermark. Empty spaces imply no agreement or completed quest. Create FOUR equally-sized keyframe panels in one horizontal row on FLAT solid muted stone-grey review background, no city scene. The SAME detached armor-lining sample mounted on SAME tabletop wooden support in each panel, fixed front-oblique camera and same scale, silhouette, tabletop baseline and anchors. Exactly one muted steel breastplate with cream padded lining attached by a small brass catch on its RIGHT inside edge. Panel1 catch closed and lining seated; panel2 catch turned outward, lining still seated; panel3 cream lining folded outward to the right exposing visibly worn inner seam, no new damage; panel4 lining fully unhooked and laid neatly on the tabletop immediately right of the same breastplate and support. Steel shell never moves, wooden support never moves, lighting never changes. No hands or people, no anatomy, no injury, no spark, no extra armor or extra fabric appearing, no motion blur, no labels. A proposed authorized sample-inspection mechanical sequence, NOT proof of consent or quest resolution. Keep the detached lining's shape and seam consistent. Large clear gutters and generous margin around each self-contained frame.
